Name: Orchid Atelier - Nine Orchid Furniture
Author: LittleEddo
Description:
ORCHID ATELIER — NINE ORCHID FURNITURE

Bring a little orchid collection into your Stardew Valley home. This set adds nine decorative furniture designs inspired by real orchids, with distinctive flowers, foliage and planters.

THE COLLECTION
• Pink Slipper Orchid — an ivory flower with a pink pouch in a cream ceramic bowl.
• Golden Cascade Orchid — cascading yellow flowers on a wooden wall mount.
• Blue Vanda Glass Vase — blue-purple blooms in a transparent footed vase.
• Amber Star Moth Orchid — small, orange-striped flowers in a grey square pot.
• Wine Velvet Moth Orchid — deep burgundy flowers in a moss-green planter.
• Moonwhite Orchid Chalice — white flowers in a polished silver chalice.
• Lavender Cattleya Glass Planter — slender, wavy purple petals and golden throats in a pale aqua glass planter.
• Wicker Dendrobium Planter — upright canes and white-and-purple flowers in a woven basket.
• Square-Mount Dendrobium — compact foliage and orange-lipped white flowers on a square wall mount.

MAIN FEATURES
• Seven ornaments and two wall decorations.
• Available from Robin's Carpenter's Shop.
• Decorative furniture with no watering or plant care required.
• English and Simplified Chinese furniture names. Some Support helper messages are currently in Chinese.
• Included Support helper adds placement support for the six tabletop orchids on standard tables, long tables, bookcases and dressers.

REQUIREMENTS
• PC Stardew Valley 1.6.9 or later within the 1.6 series.
• SMAPI 4.1.0 or later.
• Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later.

INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Download and extract OrchidAtelier-3.0.2-ModOnly.zip.
3. Place both folders directly inside your game's Mods folder:
  [CP] Orchid Atelier Nine
  [SMAPI] Orchid Atelier Support
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

Keep the two folders side by side. When updating, replace the previous folders and avoid duplicate copies.

UNINSTALLATION AND AUTOMATIC CLEANUP
1. Exit the game.
2. Delete [CP] Orchid Atelier Nine, but keep [SMAPI] Orchid Atelier Support installed.
3. Launch through SMAPI and load each save that used these orchids. The helper will automatically remove this pack's orchid items after confirming that the content pack is absent.
4. Sleep to save, then exit. Remove Support only after every affected save has been cleaned and saved.
For multiplayer saves, the host must perform cleanup with all farmhands disconnected until saving is complete.
Deleting both folders at once prevents automatic cleanup. Cleanup applies to the loaded save; historical backups and unsupported third-party private containers are not covered.

TESTING STATUS
The helper has passed compilation and API checks. Full in-game placement and multiplayer testing are still pending.

CREDITS
Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, and Pathoschild and contributors for SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Artwork was created with AI assistance and adapted and refined for the furniture sprites.
